description: Source code for the SchemeHostPortMatcher class, which manages rules for matching URL schemes, hosts, and ports, including parsing from strings, adding, replacing, evaluating, and converting rules to string.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcher
classes.description: Manages a list of URL matching rules, allowing addition, replacement, evaluation, and string conversion.

methods.name: FromRawString
methods.description: Creates a SchemeHostPortMatcher object from a raw string containing rules separated by delimiters.

methods.name: AddAsFirstRule
methods.description: Adds a rule to the beginning of the rule list.

methods.name: AddAsLastRule
methods.description: Adds a rule to the end of the rule list.

methods.name: ReplaceRule
methods.description: Replaces a rule at a specified index.

methods.name: Includes
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches the rules, returning true if included.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates rules against a URL, returning the match result.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the rule list to a string representation.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all rules from the list.
